newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Cholera death toll said rising in Guinea-Bissau.
newsitem.headline: Cholera death toll said rising in Guinea-Bissau.

text.p: The death toll from a cholera epidemic in the West African state of Guinea-Bissau has risen to 63 from 5,992 confirmed cases, Portugal's Lusa news agency reported on Friday.
Most of the cases reported were in Bissau, capital of the former Portuguese colony, the news agency quoted health ministry officials as saying.
But the disease has gradually spread to most of the country since the epidemic was officially declared in October.
Spread by poor hygiene or drinking water contaminated by sewage, cholera produces diarrhoea and dehydration. About 300 people died in an outbreak in 1994.
